request.note: Any payload. The server writes `"requested_ack" + JSON.stringify(data)` to its log and reads no field. The official client sends `{}`, only in reply to a `requesting_ack` event (js/game.js:1878-1880). The live server never sends `requesting_ack` (only a comment names it, node/server.js:13041), so in practice the official client never sends `requested_ack`.

responses.name: Nothing
responses.when: Every call. The server only writes the payload to its log.
